title: One Ångström on the 200-Femtosecond Photon Twist — WWII's 'Cat's Eyes' Carrot Radar Hoax, 1550 BCE Ox Liver, George Wald's 11-cis-Retinal Catch, Palczewski's First GPCR Crystal (PDB 1F88, 1U19), 1-ps XFEL Rhodopsin Movie (PDB 8A6C) & Active Meta II (PDB 3PQR)

teenKit.tldr: The classic parental command to eat carrots for night vision stems from a clever WWII British radar propaganda hoax built on a real biological truth dating back to ancient Egypt. Vision actually works through a quantum-level, 200-femtosecond molecular twist inside your eye triggered by a single particle of light.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how a single photon triggers a massive shape-change in your cells unlocks the biophysics of sight, revealing how life harnesses quantum-scale physics to turn light into thought.
keyTakeaways: The 1940 'Cat's Eyes' carrot rumor was a British military psyop designed to hide airborne radar technology from the Nazis.
Ancient Egyptians knew that eating ox liver cured night blindness (nyctalopia) 3,500 years before modern science isolated vitamin A and 11-cis-retinal.
Vision relies on an ultra-fast, 200-femtosecond molecular isomerization where light physically snaps a molecule's shape, captured dynamically using modern X-ray free-electron lasers.

vocab.meaning: The medical term for night blindness, caused historically by a deficiency in vitamin A which is essential for low-light vision.
A light-sensitive vitamin-A molecule tucked inside your eye's proteins that instantly changes shape when it absorbs a photon.
One quadrillionth of a second, representing the blistering speed limit at which molecules undergo physical changes during vision.
A massive cell-surface protein family, like rhodopsin, that acts as a cellular molecular switch to transmit external signals inside the cell.

quiz.question: What was the primary real-world purpose behind the British Royal Air Force's 1940 carrot propaganda campaign?
options: To boost the national carrot farming industry during wartime supply shortages
To conceal the tactical use of airborne radar technology from German bombers
To cure widespread night blindness caused by wartime vitamin shortages
To trick enemy spies into eating toxic amounts of root vegetables
quiz.explanation: The British spread the rumor that pilots ate carrots to sharpen their night vision in order to hide the fact that secret onboard radar was helping them intercept enemy planes in the dark.

quiz.question: At the microscopic scale, what fundamental physical event does light perform to initiate human vision?
options: It heats up the retina to trigger thermal nerve impulses
It splits water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen inside the cornea
It isomerizes 11-cis-retinal into a different molecular shape in fractions of a picosecond
It directly charges cellular batteries by generating a massive electrical current
quiz.explanation: As George Wald and modern biophysicists discovered, the sole job of light in vision is to isomerize (twist) the 11-cis-retinal molecule straight into a new shape within 200 femtoseconds.

quiz.question: How far back does human awareness of the link between diet and night blindness actually stretch?
options: To World War II British radar laboratories in 1940
To George Wald's Nobel Prize-winning laboratory work in 1935
To ancient Egyptian medical texts like the Ebers Papyrus around 1550 BCE
To the invention of the first crystal protein structure (PDB 1F88) in 2000
quiz.explanation: Ancient Egyptians recorded using ox liver to treat night blindness around 1550 BCE in the Ebers Papyrus, long before science understood vitamin A.
